paper_title: The Safety Reminder A Soft Prompt to Reactivate Delayed Safety   Awareness in Vision-Language Models
caption: The proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how the metric labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” changes across four x-axis settings for four model/dataset combinations shown in the legend. The x-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and shows discrete numeric tick marks at 128, 256, 512, and 1024 (spaced by 128 between the first two ticks and by larger intervals thereafter as labeled). The y-axis is labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 0.0 up to about 0.55 with major tick labels at regular 0.1 intervals. Four solid lines are plotted: a blue line with circle markers (“LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep”) rises from about 0.20 at x=128 to ~0.25 at 256, ~0.35 at 512, and ~0.36 at 1024; an orange line with square markers (“Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep”) increases from ~0.15 at 128 to ~0.23 at 256 and ~0.42 at 512, then remains approximately flat at ~0.42 at 1024; a green line with triangle markers (“LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench”) increases from ~0.065 at 128 to ~0.215 at 256 and ~0.37 at 512, then changes slightly to ~0.38 at 1024; and a red line with diamond markers (“Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench”) increases from ~0.245 at 128 to ~0.265 at 256 and ~0.425 at 512, then rises further to ~0.515 at 1024.
